content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria, where platforms like Stripe and PayPal have been severely restricted, and you're stuck with a digital store that can't accept [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-3|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|crypto]] payments for free. You've been searching for a way to build a crypto store that bypasses these limitations, and you've finally found the solution on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-2|Cloudflare R2]] Pages. No more waiting for a workaround, no more worrying about platform restrictions - this guide will walk you through the step-by-step process of building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, no Stripe required.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages, combined with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, provides a robust payment and delivery pipeline that allows you to accept crypto payments directly on your store, without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe. With this infrastructure, you can deploy your store in 4-6 hours, using the Sovereign Blueprint, and start selling digital products immediately. The beauty of this setup lies in its flexibility and scalability, allowing you to adapt to any market conditions and grow your business without dependency on any third-party services.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start building your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need a few essential tools and services. First, you'll need a Cloudflare account and a GitHub account, as well as some basic coding knowledge to set up your store's backend logic. You'll also need to sign up for NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Pages. Don't worry if you're new to coding or haven't used these services before - this guide will walk you through the process step-by-step.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your tools and services in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves configuring your Cloudflare Pages store to accept crypto payments through NOWPayments, as well as setting up automated file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You'll also need to configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email verification, ensuring your store's emails are delivered to your customers' inboxes, not spam folders.
The entire sovereign stack — hosting, payments, delivery, order storage — has zero monthly cost after the one-time deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and start processing transactions. With your store live on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to test your payment flow to ensure it's working correctly, and then start promoting your store to your customers. This is also a good time to check out the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a more comprehensive solution that includes Stack 02, deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store up and running, it's time to think about scaling. As your business grows, you'll need to adapt your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This guide will provide you with the tools and knowledge you need to scale your store, including tips on how to optimize your website for better performance and how to handle increased traffic.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question you should be asking is: 'Can I really build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages without relying on Stripe or PayPal?' The answer is yes, and with this guide, you'll have the tools and knowledge you need to do it. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you'll be able to set up a secure and scalable store that accepts crypto payments directly, without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe. So, what are you waiting for? Start building your crypto store today and join the COREMERCH community!
Test a real mainnet transaction before you promote — finding a configuration error with your own crypto costs less than finding it with a buyer's.

The Edge Commerce Stack offers a comprehensive solution that includes Stack 02, deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. With this solution, you'll be able to take your crypto store to the next level and enjoy the features and benefits that come with a more advanced infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Here's a step-by-step checklist to help you build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages: Create a Cloudflare account and set up your store's backend logic; Sign up for NOWPayments and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages store; Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email verification; Set up automated file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; Test your payment flow to ensure it's working correctly; Go live and start promoting your store to your customers; Monitor and optimize your store's performance as traffic increases.
